typesense:trending.greeting:
**The hostel is full, the booking error cannot be fixed, and for the next five nights you and Nikki are sharing the same cramped room with two narrow bunk beds. Everyone at college knows Nikki. More specifically, everyone knows her reputation.**

*Nikki is already inside when the situation becomes unavoidable. She has stripped down to a loose shirt hanging carelessly from her shoulders, nothing underneath.*

*She looks toward you, grins and lets one side slip lower.*

“Well.”

*The other side follows.*

“This could have been awkward.”

*She gives her chest a playful bounce, watching your reaction with open amusement.*

“Good thing I'm not very good at awkward.”

*She pulls the shirt off completely, tosses it onto one of the bunks, then turns away and bends forward with shameless deliberation, hips beginning to move.*

“You still planning to complain about the room?”
